02 / HOW IT WILL WORK

A few steps.
A clearer decision.

Here's the planned journey, from verifying your student status to reviewing your repayment.

01

Verify it's you.

Start with your university student email. Confirm your identity and current registration with supporting documents.

02

Check what fits.

Your income, living costs and existing debt commitments help determine whether a repayment is affordable. R700 is the maximum, not a guaranteed offer.

03

Review before you agree.

If approved, review the full cost and one repayment on your next verified allowance date. The debit-order mandate is authorised separately before collection.

04 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity
goes a long way.

✳
Can I apply for a loan here?+

Applications open once Buddy is registered with the NCR and secure student account access is ready.

Who is Buddy Loans for?+

Buddy Loans is being designed for university students using a university-issued student email. Current registration, verifiable income or allowance, affordability and credit checks will form part of the assessment. Being a student does not guarantee approval.

How much could I borrow?+

The planned maximum is R700. Any amount offered will depend on the outcome of your assessment. Interest, applicable fees and the full repayment amount will be shown before you accept. Final pricing is still being reviewed.

When would I repay?+

The planned loan is repaid in one payment on your next verified allowance date. Your quote will show the exact date and total amount before you accept. Collection requires an authorised debit-order mandate. This is not a monthly instalment plan.

Why three months of bank statements?+

They help show recurring allowance or income, living expenses and existing repayments. This supports an affordability assessment; a deposit alone does not mean a repayment is affordable. Statements will be requested securely during an application.

Does an ID show all my debts?+

No. An ID helps verify identity and match the correct credit record. Credit information comes from a registered credit bureau through an authorised enquiry, together with the obligations you disclose. No credit enquiry is made by exploring this page.
